The provided evidence reports 29 Total Recordable Injuries, 2 Total Lost Time Injuries, and 1 Case of Work-Related Ill-Health. These outcome metrics do not substantiate the existence of the belief or policy standard, and the occurrence of injuries indicates that health and safety were compromised in multiple instances. The evidence fails to verify the claim's material meaning regarding safety standards and uncompromised activities, leaving the decisive assertion ungrounded.
